name: clean_premium
description: Brand-film look: sparse centered statement captions, a barely-there grade, slow tasteful punch-ins, and a light SFX touch. The 'expensive and calm' aesthetic — minimal motion, lets the subject and the words carry it.

grade.notes: subtle = eq=contrast=1.03:saturation=0.98. Almost imperceptible cleanup, no color shift. Premium reads as natural, not graded.

captions.notes: Centered short statement phrases, lowercase, gentle fade. NOT every word — only the line that matters. Place near vertical center, not the lower third.

punch_in.notes: Slow, tasteful 6% push that ramps over ~12 frames. Use the animated punch on key statements; static elsewhere.

pacing.notes: Let shots breathe. Long holds are fine when the line lands.

transition.notes: Hard cuts still dominate. A slow 0.5s cross-dissolve only at true section breaks.

sfx.notes: A single soft whoosh under the occasional dissolve. Nothing percussive.

notes: The Counza brand-film / 'founder on a sofa, beautifully lit' look. Restraint is the style: few captions, slow pushes, near-zero SFX. If in doubt, do less.
